definitions.explanation: Television or radio broadcasting transmitted from ground-based stations, as opposed to satellite or cable broadcasting.

examples.japanese: {地上波|ちじょうは}で{放送|ほうそう}する。
その{試合|しあい}は{地上波|ちじょうは}では{見|み}られない。
examples.english: That game can't be watched on terrestrial TV.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{地上波|ちじょうは}より{動画|どうが}サイトでテレビ{番組|ばんぐみ}を{見|み}る{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Recently more people watch TV programs on video sites than on terrestrial TV.

notes:
Composed of {地上|ちじょう} (ground, on the surface) + {波|は} (wave). Refers to broadcasts sent over the air from ground-based transmitters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地上波|ちじょうは}{放送|ほうそう}: terrestrial broadcasting
- {地上波|ちじょうは}で{流|なが}す: to air on terrestrial TV
- {地上波|ちじょうは}デジタル: terrestrial digital broadcasting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {衛星|えいせい}{放送|ほうそう}: satellite broadcasting — delivered via satellite
- ケーブルテレビ: cable TV — delivered through cable lines
